verdict.rationale: Kimi documents web search as a core feature: the help center lists search and a Deep Research product, and the Code CLI and editor docs mention web search. A hands-on report shows Thinking mode pulling from Wikipedia to answer a question. Citations back to sources are never evidenced, and the help-center entries are only topic titles. missing for 10: documented inline citations/source links in answers, detail on how search grounding and Deep Research work, independent corroboration of citation quality.
